notes: David Gets In Trouble is part of David Shannon's No David series. The core theme is a child making excuses and deflecting blame before ultimately feeling remorseful and saying sorry — making 'trouble', 'sorry', 'accident', 'blame', and 'cry' particularly high-value fringe words for comprehension and retell. 'Blame' may not have a direct Boardmaker symbol — consider 'point' or 'not me' as fallback search terms. The fixed core already includes 'finished', 'uh oh', 'I don't know', and 'no', which all appear frequently in this book and will support participation without needing fringe slots.
